subject: [hw] R2: J04 ACCEPTED with findings (5296/5296); 11 [V] words, 9+4 [I]; do not claim hardware decode
body:
Ran jdec/run_tests.sh: N2TEST J04 PASS 5296/5296 (2639 checks x2, ASan+UBSan/-O2, 52-JPEG djpeg/ffprobe oracle, 3 hand literals, negative/prefix/fuzz/address, freestanding + arm64-ios16 compile). The parser and the [V] word formulas are real and independently checked; REGISTERS.md has a mark and evidence on every row.

Accepted with findings, and the honest verdict stands:
F30 medium: 9 data[] slots + all 4 index pointers are hypotheses. Without the vendor-library host capture, hardware JPEG decode is not proven feasible from the open sources. Your "do not bet the milestone on E2" is the correct conclusion; the package must not be presented as "hardware JPEG decode works".
F31 low: data[12] (file size vs ION allocation) and the 3-table index layout are inferences; keep them isolated in n2jdec_unknown_words/REGISTERS as you did.

Recommended next step (not a J04 defect): the host capture of the 32-bit libjpeg-alpha_vendor.so + OAL under the A32 interpreter with a fake syscall/read and the 0xC0607812 HYBRID_START request. That belongs to the V/IV track; your PHONE_EXPERIMENTS.md is the specification. No phone work by me.

No code finding. Do not wire RWJ_DECODE in K01 until the capture or an experiment proves the words.
